# Leeks Terminal

> HK + US day-trade AI decision dashboard. 200 HK stocks + 200 US stocks, 4-dim scoring + rule-based decision engine. Self-built, self-used, self-funded. Day trading requires high risk, past performance does not guarantee future returns.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://www.win9you.com/): Daily dashboard index, latest 14 dates
- [Dashboard Hub](https://www.win9you.com/dashboard/): Filter by date / market / operation
- [Methodology](https://www.win9you.com/methodology.html): 4-dim scoring + rule engine + backtest
- [FAQ](https://www.win9you.com/faq.html): 10 common questions
- [Insights](https://www.win9you.com/insights.html): 9-day audit of 1,913 signals
- [Paper Trades](https://www.win9you.com/paper-trades.html): Live paper trade tracker
- [About](https://www.win9you.com/about.html): Story and mission
- [Learn Hub](https://www.win9you.com/learn/): Educational articles

## Data Sources
- HK live: Tencent qtimg (1-15 min delay)
- US live: YFinance / Alpaca (15-20 min delay)
- News: Futu / Yahoo Finance RSS
- Fundamentals: YFinance (PE/PB/ROE/market cap)

## Operating Window
- Daily auto-update: 16:00 HKT (HK close) + 16:00 ET (US close)
- Day-trade only: 4 PM HKT / 4 PM ET close by, no overnight holds (3-day timeout enforced)
- Universe refresh: every 5 trading days (200 HK + 200 US)

## Operating Rules (Active)
- Anti-Chase: BLOCK BUY + m≥60 + optimistic + today≥+3%
- Anti-Knife: BLOCK SELL + pessimistic + today≤-3%
- Conservative BUY: 6-filter mean-reversion (US only, n=16, 81% WR paper)
- HSI Bear Gate: HSI chg ≤ -1.5% suppresses BUY signals
- 3-day timeout: force close any position held >3 days
- Data Guard (2026-08-02): if MA20/MA50/RSI14 all missing, force HOLD

## Operating Rules (PAUSED 2026-08-02)
- Bounce preset: 67 closed trades at 43.3% WR, -0.24% avg (-$160)
- Cyber BUY preset: 5 trades at -2.97% avg
- SELL signals: 1D hit rate 52.9% but mean-reverts avg +0.86% (wrong direction)
